text:
**Short answer:** Most iPhone drivers should get the Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 vent mount. If you want the fastest charging, get the Anker Prime.

**My picks**

1. **Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount (best for most people), about $47.99**
   - It includes a 27W car adapter and a USB-C cable, and rotates between portrait and landscape.
   - It fits cases up to 3 mm thick.
   - It needs vent slats up to 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep. Straight horizontal slats work best, and vertical or shallow ones can droop. ([RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/))
   - If your vents are a poor fit, the same sources suggest Belkin's vent/dash version at the same price.

2. **Anker Prime Qi2 25W with active cooling (best performance), $89.99 list**
   - It has thermoelectric cooling plus a fan, which helps on hot days with navigation running. One roundup showed it discounted to $69.99. ([The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/))
   - Mountguys uses it as their daily driver and says its vent clip holds more securely than Belkin or Apple vent mounts. ([Mountguys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/))
   - Reviews differ on the adapter: The Gadgeteer and Mountguys say a 60W adapter is in the box, while RottenWiFi says you need a 45W+ adapter for 25W. Check the listing before you buy.
   - Full 25W only works on newer phones (iPhone 17 and 16 Pro Max/Plus). Older iPhones get about 15W.
   - Anker excludes Tesla and Mercedes-Benz vehicles, cars without vent blades, and nonstandard vents.

3. **ESR HaloLock 15W with CryoBoost fan (best value), $39.99**
   - It has a built-in fan to reduce heat throttling and works on a vent or dash.
   - The code PARTNER18 took it to $32.80 in ESR's cart on Oct 25, though codes can change. ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-discount-codes))
   - Buy it here (affiliate link, no extra cost to you): https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost
   - A car adapter may not be included, so check the listing.

4. **LISEN 15W dash/vent mount (budget), about $15.99**
   - It has strong magnets (24 magnets, up to 3800gf claimed) and fits both vent and dash. It needs a car charger that supplies at least 18W per port. ([RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/))
   - The same review sources also list a LISEN 25W fan model from $39.95. ([The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/))

**Where to buy:** The search results didn't include direct product-page links for the Belkin, Anker, or LISEN, so I won't guess at URLs. The review pages above each have "Buy on Amazon" links, or you can search the exact product names on Amazon.

**Before you buy**
- Look for "Qi2" certification. "MagSafe-compatible" without it may only charge at 7.5W.
- Ignore "80 lb suction" claims, which describe the dash suction cup and not the phone grip.
- If you don't want a charging cable, Mountguys recommends the non-charging VICSEED steel-core vent mount.
- If you tell me your phone, car, and vent type, I can narrow this to one pick.
